title: collaboration_respond input
description: Either party responds to the collaboration reference: acknowledge it, confirm the reported outcome, dispute it with a statement and optionally the SHA-256 of evidence it keeps, or withdraw it before work starts. A dispute is shown to both parties and kept with its statement; the network doesn't judge it, and either publisher may raise it with EuKollab.

action.description: acknowledge from proposed; confirm from reported_completed; dispute from any state before withdrawn or disputed; withdraw from proposed or acknowledged.

evidence_digest.description: Optional SHA-256, lowercase hex, of evidence you keep; the evidence itself never goes to the network.

examples.statement: Two of five results were empty although the receipts say succeeded.
